turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ad-spend-per-order metric, so I can't give that ratio; the closest metrics are Ad spend (EUR), 6270.0 EUR for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, and Orders filtered to non-cancelled status (placed or shipped), 110 orders placed 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 (related ratio metrics are cost per lead and cost per booking).
